text: Plan: regenerate the ten-part conditional prototype from the unchanged BOM through schematic.intent.json and draft_schematic, synchronize PINOUT/current documentation, and run all original checks afresh. The prior refused attempt was rolled back and supplies no current pass or artifact. Keep the two power rails distinct, all pin assignments and electrical budgets unchanged, and all physical qualification pending.

args.why: Capture the existing ten-part conditional prototype BOM and exact pin contract into a real non-empty schematic using the required deterministic intent workflow, without changing electrical targets or claiming physical qualification.
args.what_changes:
- Author schematic.intent.json and generate the configured schematic with draft_schematic; preserve exact BOM refdes, values, footprints, six nets and intentional no-connects.
- Tighten four relevant SUBSYSTEMS.md headings if needed for readable group captions; update current schematic status and PINOUT.md from the implemented assignments.
- Confirm canonical installed symbol pins rather than substituting parts because an MPN-only name search misses generic connector/passive/LED symbols.
- Run symbol, ERC, legibility and drift checks and reconcile actual findings; preserve all physical, procurement and PCB checks as pending.
- Inspect fresh generated-symbol verification and inherited U1 metadata; do not carry any previous failed-run gate result forward.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Confirm installed pin maps and scaffold; read PINOUT and affected evidence/status text.
- [ ] Capture all ten BOM parts and six nets with every unused pin explicitly declared in intent; generate the schematic.
- [ ] Update PINOUT and documentation/constraints to distinguish captured schematic evidence from outstanding physical qualification.
- [ ] Run verify_symbols, run_erc, check_legibility and check_drift; repair via intent and redraft if needed.
- [ ] Read back changed documentation and record decisions/constraints; finish only after original gates pass.
